findings.detail: Reviewer me independently read the uploaded source ZIP, compared the files with the bound draft and attestation, inspected the guard/runner/call path, and executed separate mock-backend tests. The review was not produced by the implementation assistant. Cluster tokenizer and weight files were not independently accessible; the cluster attestation is user-supplied and independently checked for internal consistency and source/manifest bindings. No real-model inference was run.

The supplied v4 draft and attestation match their included ZIP copies; their canonical seals recompute, their cross-hashes match the execution-review template, and all 79 attested source files are present with matching raw SHA-256. Source hashes of the revised runner, guard, and test file match the declared attestation. Uploaded ZIP SHA-256: 1a7033b468a3a3120b884704a9da08509dbec765186c31fab1be0564847c41ce.

The actual QueryOnlyVictim loads only the frozen query entry. The guard enforces exact scheduled edited input, generation settings, exact runtime field keys and prefix, target absence, no truncation, and equality of returned serialization/tokens. A counter caps attempts at four probes plus two anchors; rejected nested runtime keys cause no attempted inference. No fallback to observation/reference is coded, and runner uses no defender calls or automatic retries.

The repaired runner imports sys and returns CLI code 2 on stored backend failures. Independent tests on the actual runner and guard with fake backends verified six-attempt success, one-attempt malformed/unscorable stop, one-attempt inference exception, stable/unstable anchors, one-attempt wrong serialized prompt, no repeat in an occupied output folder, and identical immutable failure result bytes on attempted reruns. The runner requires SLURM_JOB_ID and re-runs attestation before loading a victim.

All four attested complete serialized prompts match their UTF-8 SHA-256, include the frozen policy_input, omit case-insensitive target adidas, and have identical encoded/full token-ID lists of lengths 256,255,252,251 against max_input_tokens=2048. The first pair is repeated as two anchors. Independent offline reconstruction of the attestation succeeded with injected metadata views; this is not independent execution of the cluster tokenizer. At run time, the runner recomputes the complete attestation with the actual tokenizer and compares it byte-for-byte to the approved attestation before loading weights.

Only query checkpoint cp_a17f829c041e is enabled. Its SHA-256 weight identity is consistent with the frozen nine-file weight inventory and the attested inventory, and the query entry hash matches the draft and attestation. Cluster checkpoint files are not in the ZIP and were not independently rehashed by this reviewer. The production attestation re-audits checkpoint files and rejects mismatches before loading the model.

Resource approval is granted for no more than six physical next-search inference attempts on the single bound query checkpoint: four specified probe attempts and at most two anchor attempts. Zero observation, reference, and defender calls, no automatic retries, and early fail-closed termination. This approval is not for running a method matrix, a larger pilot, or confirmation.

Execution approval is granted for this exact draft and attestation on the existing Slurm-only runner, provided its enforced live attestation equals the approved attestation and the frozen source and model configuration remain unchanged. That preflight is a runtime gate, not evidence that a real query inference has happened. If the gate fails, no inference is approved under changed inputs/sources and a new attestation and review are required.

The exercise is an evaluator-budget-revised, prior-agent-selected, post-inspection constructed ankle-boots versus athletic-shoes comparison, not task-preserving incident replay or fresh discovery. Preserve both binary arm outcomes and D=boots minus athletic shoes, with [0,1] -> -1 and [0,0]/[1,1] both 0 but substantively distinct. All four hypothetical outcomes, tied broader/constant rules, five unassessed hypotheses and outside-family possibilities remain; no result identifies a unique mechanism or establishes unauthorized action, poisoning cause, semantic trigger, or purchase-level attack success.

The ZIP contains the declared integration-test source and a one-test passing cluster log, but omits imported helper modules including test_hacs and audit_continuation; the packaged test cannot be reproduced directly in this extracted ZIP. The reviewer instead executed 10 independent mock-backed checks exercising the actual attached production runner and guard, using a locally injected ROOT path for the omitted audit_continuation helper. All 10 passed. These tests do not substitute for the real cluster runtime preflight.
